provenance.sourceQuality: Closing equity direction corroborated externally; repository refresh after early close is not a live cash quote. Exact rate timestamps unavailable. Oil and VXN not freshly verified; prior readings labeled stale.
provenance.marketVsCatalyst: Friday gains observed; weekend oil and next-week data effects prospective. Open Watch refreshed but newest listed events dated Nov 25, no new dated catalyst after previous assessment.

editorial.marketOverview: Friday closed with Nasdaq up 2.31% and SOX up 4.69%, corroborated by external closing reports. The repository reports QQQ up 2.69% and positive breadth; an external report puts QQQ at 2.66%. The difference is small but exact synchronization is unverified.
editorial.whatChanged: The close strengthened semiconductor relative performance from 1.71 to 2.38 percentage points versus the earlier snapshot. The repository score nevertheless fell from +10 to -7. Open Watch refreshed, but its newest listed events remain dated November 25; no new dated catalyst was identified.
editorial.marketInterpretation: The rebound is broad enough to retain neutral bias, not enough to establish a durable uptrend. Treasury yields remain elevated and the reported VIX decline is encouraging but still leaves volatility elevated. Current VXN and oil contract levels are not verified; prior Fed pricing is stale, though Reuters corroborates tightening expectations.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 30 tests the rally under normal liquidity and the weekend OPEC+ outcome. Tuesday December 1 brings ISM and JOLTS, with Credo earnings listed in the repository but not issuer-confirmed. Wednesday December 2 ADP adds labor-market rate risk ahead of Friday payrolls outside the horizon.
editorial.bullCase: Continued semiconductor leadership, positive breadth and easing volatility could extend the rebound if yields stabilize. Friday's gains are supportive evidence, not a forecast guarantee.
editorial.bearCase: A reversal of holiday gains, higher oil or a move above 5% in the ten-year yield could revive selling. Existing inflation, Nvidia governance and trade risks remain relevant; no isolated causal reaction is established.
editorial.watchNext: Check Monday cash breadth and SOX relative strength, fresh VXN/VIX, paired Treasury yields and matched oil contracts. Verify Fed pricing and issuer earnings dates; monitor JOLTS and ISM surprises against expectations.
